# Kahanio

> Kahanio is a free AI reel maker by ClientoraHQ. Type a topic or script and get a short video (9:16 or 16:9 MP4) with word-by-word captions, an AI voice in English, Urdu or Hindi, music made for each video and real stock footage from Pexels. It runs in the browser, needs no sign-up and puts no watermark over the video; a short end card credits the footage.

## Facts
- Price: free. No account needed.
- Templates: Story, Bold Pop, Clean, Neon Night, Chat, Cartoon (a 2D presenter with lip-sync), Headline.
- Voices: English (on-device and online), Urdu (Uzma, Asad), Hindi (Swara, Madhur); Hindi letters can be spoken by an Urdu voice; or the user's own recording.
- Captions: word by word; Urdu in Nastaliq. A .srt file is included.
- Photos: users can add photos that move with slow 3D camera motion.
- Privacy: the video is made in the browser; only scene text is sent for online voices.
- Source code: GPL-3.0, https://github.com/star-anonymus/kahanio
- Made by ClientoraHQ (https://clientorahq.com), which finds clients for freelancers and agencies.
